findings.title: A code field that deletes Arabic digits
findings.message: Typing ١٢ into this code field kept neither ١٢ nor 12, so Arabic digits are deleted.
findings.fix: Accept Arabic-Indic digits and convert them to 0 to 9 before checking or sending the value, instead of stripping them.
findings.snippet: <input type="text" class="otp-input" maxlength="1" inputmode="numeric" pattern="[0-9]" autocomplete="one-time-code" autofocus="">

findings.title: A left-to-right field typed right to left
findings.message: This code field inherits right to left.
findings.fix: Add dir="ltr" to the input, or dir="auto" if people may type Arabic too.
findings.snippet: <input type="text" class="otp-input" maxlength="1" inputmode="numeric" pattern="[0-9]" autocomplete="one-time-code" autofocus="">

findings.title: No Arabic font in the stack
findings.message: "IBM Plex Sans Arabic" is named but never loaded.
findings.fix: Load an Arabic family with @font-face or a font link and name it in the stack, for example "IBM Plex Sans Arabic".
